standard: yEnc Body & Control Lines Encryption Standards v1.2

vectors.description: Standard two-file encrypted release parsed as plain NZB 1.1 segments
vectors.nzb_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE nzb PUBLIC "-//newzBin//DTD NZB 1.1//EN" "http://www.newzbin.com/DTD/nzb/nzb-1.1.dtd">
<nzb xmlns="http://www.newzbin.com/DTD/2003/nzb">
  <head>
    <meta type="password">test123</meta>
    <meta type="yenc_encrypted">true</meta>
  </head>
  <file poster="poster@example.com" date="1774300000" subject="[1/2] - "file1.bin" yEnc (1/2)">
    <groups>
      <group>alt.binaries.test</group>
    </groups>
    <segments>
      <segment bytes="750000" number="1">art-1@example.com</segment>
      <segment bytes="750000" number="2">art-2@example.com</segment>
    </segments>
  </file>
  <file poster="poster@example.com" date="1774300000" subject="[2/2] - "file2.bin" yEnc (1/1)">
    <groups>
      <group>alt.binaries.test</group>
    </groups>
    <segments>
      <segment bytes="500000" number="1">art-3@example.com</segment>
    </segments>
  </file>
</nzb>
